sources.title: Multilingual agents — Dialogflow CX
sources.supports: A production distinction between shared agent state and language-specific/control-plane data with documented switching limits.
sources.does_not_establish: That a user-visible continuity failure is caused by memory rather than configuration or locale routing.

sources.title: HINDSIGHT: Structured Agent Memory that Retains, Recalls, and Reflects
sources.supports: An inspectable persistent-memory architecture and an explicit English-only evidence boundary.
sources.does_not_establish: Multilingual state continuity or language-switch behavior.

inspection_spans.observation: HINDSIGHT separates facts, beliefs, and observations in persistent memory with parallel retrieval and temporal organization.
inspection_spans.does_not_establish: Multilingual state continuity or language-switch behavior.

inspection_spans.observation: Evaluation is English-only; extraction errors can propagate and opinion evolution lacks formal user validation.
inspection_spans.does_not_establish: Multilingual state continuity or language-switch behavior.

sources.title: Design effective language understanding — Microsoft Copilot Studio
sources.supports: A production language control plane that can reroute search, response, and orchestration independently of remembered task facts.
sources.does_not_establish: Observed memory loss, failure prevalence, or the correctness of automatic detection.

inspection_spans.observation: System.User.Language is the central control point for knowledge search and response language and can be set, overridden, or automatically detected.
inspection_spans.does_not_establish: Observed memory loss, failure prevalence, or the correctness of automatic detection.

inspection_spans.observation: Critical content may require custom translation; multilingual deployments require synchronization, testing, fallback, and monitoring.
inspection_spans.does_not_establish: Observed memory loss, failure prevalence, or the correctness of automatic detection.

sources.title: PolyWorkBench: Benchmarking Multilingual Long-Horizon LLM Agents
sources.supports: A multilingual long-horizon workflow benchmark and evidence that errors compound across execution steps.
sources.does_not_establish: Isolation of persistent-memory loss from language control, harness, judge, or task-design effects.

inspection_spans.observation: The benchmark embeds multilingual inputs, intermediate reasoning, tools, and outputs in 67 long-horizon tasks across five domains.
inspection_spans.does_not_establish: Isolation of persistent-memory loss from language control, harness, judge, or task-design effects.

inspection_spans.observation: Strict arithmetic or schema errors can invalidate entire workflows, so aggregate Pass@1 can misrepresent reliability.
inspection_spans.does_not_establish: Isolation of persistent-memory loss from language control, harness, judge, or task-design effects.

inspection_spans.observation: Results vary across task domains and languages; the benchmark plans to expand rather than establishing a universal workflow distribution.
inspection_spans.does_not_establish: Isolation of persistent-memory loss from language control, harness, judge, or task-design effects.
